description:
About the Scholarship

The Vice Chancellor's Global Impact and Leadership Scholarship rewards outstanding international students with GBP 10,000 towards their postgraduate tuition fees. The application process asks you to clearly and concisely explain how studying at UEA will help you to contribute to your chosen field of study and become a global leader.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Type of CoursePostgraduate Taught Course
Start DateJanuary 2027
Fee StatusInternational Fees and Self-Funded
NationalityInternational — Asia, Africa, South America, Middle East, North America, Australia, EU, Europe
AcademicAt least a 2:1, or equivalent, in undergraduate degree
OfferMust hold a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible PGT course

Benefit

ComponentDetails
Total ValueGBP 10,000 towards tuition fees
Combination rulesCannot be held with any other UEA scholarship except International Early Payment Award
Replacement ruleIf eligible for another UEA scholarship of higher value, that automatically replaces this one

Application Process

Applications are submitted in written format. You will need to answer two questions:

  1. Why did you select UEA and apply for your chosen course? (max 200 words)
  2. If you could change one thing in your country, what would it be, and how would that impact society? (max 200 words)

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application deadline23:59 (BST) on Friday, 30 October 2026
Start dateJanuary 2027

About UEA

The University of East Anglia is a public research university in Norwich, England, with a strong tradition of welcoming international students. The Vice Chancellor's Scholarship reflects UEA's commitment to developing global leaders.

Official Link: Apply on UEA portal

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 October 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
